payload.summary: Targeted IMPL_FIX round 2 resolved the deterministic decision-drift blocker and all closely related lifecycle/reuse compatibility findings. Independent verification passed 349 supervise tests, ruff, installed-skill sync, strict validation of all 89 OpenSpec items, and diff integrity.
completed_work: Detected record-versus-digest decision drift and rebuilt maintained digests from validated caches
Added an explicit non-empty force-reuse probe before analyst dispatch
Converted missing or invalid reuse caches into an unavailable result that permits analyst fallback
Rejected terminal same-key re-admission while preserving durable terminal history
Validated legacy refine-roadmap references during durable-record sanitization
Added regression coverage for ordinary and forced decision drift, reuse fallback, terminal re-admission, and malformed legacy records

decisions.title: Expose cache reuse as a probe
decisions.rationale: The host must distinguish a successful digest reuse from an unavailable cache that should proceed to analyst scoring without treating either as corruption.

decisions.title: Reject terminal same-key re-admission
decisions.rationale: Silently accepting a key with durable approved or rejected history creates invisible work and capacity loss; explicit rejection preserves deterministic lifecycle semantics.

next_steps: Proceed to validation only if the implementation review converges
